sloka: सहस्राक्षस्य तत् कर्म विज्ञाय मुनिपुंगवः ।रंभाम् क्रोध समाविष्टः शशाप कुशिक आत्मजः ॥१-६४-११॥
transliteration: sahasrākṣasya tat karma vijñāya munipuṁgavaḥ ।raṁbhām krodha samāviṣṭaḥ śaśāpa kuśika ātmajaḥ ॥1-64-11॥

translations.english: Son of Kushika, the eminent ascetic knew it was the work of Indra. Seized with anger, he cursed Rambha:
